audience: teams that collect leads, orders and answers through Jotform forms

useCases.title: Read the latest submissions
useCases.text: List the newest submissions of one form with their answers, or across all forms of the account.

useCases.title: Look up one answer by question id
useCases.text: Read one submission with every answer, then the question properties behind an answer key.

useCases.title: Find uploaded files and webhooks
useCases.text: List the files uploaded through a form and the webhook URLs that receive its submissions.

useCases.title: Check forms and monthly usage
useCases.text: List the forms with their submission counts, and read this month's usage counters for the account.

useCases.title: Organize forms with labels
useCases.text: Create a label, then list the labels and the assets that carry them.

useCases.title: Clone a form as a starting point
useCases.text: Read a form, then copy it with its questions and settings. The original form stays unchanged.
